title: Wild Crispy American Baby Lettuce Salad
description: A quick and easy paleo-friendly salad featuring crispy baby lettuce leaves and a tangy yuzu cure, perfect for a snack or light lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Add the baby lettuce leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
If using, cook the crispy bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then chop into bits.
If using, shave the parmesan cheese over the salad.
To make the salad crispy, heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a slotted spoon, carefully add a few handfuls of the dressed baby lettuce leaves to the hot oil and fry until crispy, about 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Remove the crispy lettuce leaves from the oil with the slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining baby lettuce leaves.
To assemble the salad, place the crispy baby lettuce leaves on a serving plate, then top with additional dressing, crispy bacon bits, and shaved parmesan cheese if using.
